Cops get a call for an accidental shooting, but when they arrive at the scene and see a deceased man, evidence points to foul play; a man is arrested in an undercover drug deal and prostitution solicitation; a traffic stop.
Cops chase after two males in an SUV until it flips; a domestic disturbance call is made involving a child custody dispute; officers detain and tase a fleeing suspect for selling heroin.

Officers stop a man on a bike who matches the description of a robbery suspect, the man runs until he falls and is arrested; three men are detained when found hanging out in a heavy drug alley; a boyfriend is arrested for pushing his girlfriend.

Officers find a man in someone else's home who is wanted for domestic violence restraining order and a burglary; a man tries to swallow a bag of weed as he is pulled over; a woman stabs another man in the arm with scissors and is arrested.
